_about: Pacing (js/pacing.js): the lines the pacing layer composes. Surveillance-terse, like the transmission log. Every line states only what is true of the city at that moment. Placeholders as in the storylets: {A} the subject, {B.desc} someone near, {A.first}/{A.full}/{A.nick} teach that name, {B.rel}/{B.addr} state a relation, {place} a building or open place by id, {when} a clock time, {n} a count, {S} and {L} short phrases filled in by the code.

keeper: Overheard: the keeper, already reaching for a bowl: "{A.first}. Same again?"
Overheard: the keeper calls {A} up by name: "{A.first}, you're next."
neighbor: Overheard: {B.desc}, from a few steps off: "{A.first}! {S}."
coworker: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "{A.first}. See you in there."
Overheard: {B.desc} falls in beside {A}: "{A.first}. Walk with me."
household: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "{A.first}, did you lock up?"
Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "{A.first}. Keys." {A} checks a pocket.
tag: Tag at {A.his} collar, readable at this range: {A.first}.
comm: Comm, one side: "{A.first} here. Go ahead."
Comm, one side: "Yes, this is {A.first}." A pause. "Now?"
Comm, one side: {A}: "It's {A.first}. I'm on my way."
radio: Radio: "{A.first}, check in." {A} keys the handset. "Checking in."
Radio: "Unit {n}, {A.first}, what's your location?" {A} gives a cross street.
partner: Overheard: {B.desc}, across the corner: "{A.first}, you see anything?" {A} shakes {A.his} head.

job: Work ID on {A}, held up at the door: {A.job}.
home: Door plate at {place}: {A.full}. {A}'s print opens the lock.
Lock at {place} reads {A}'s print. Name on the plate: {A.full}.
regular: {A} at {place} again. Seen there on {seen} separate days.
{place}, again. {seen} days on record for {A} here.
habit: {A} out of {place} at {when}. Same hour, give or take, {seen} days running.
intro: Overheard: {A} to someone at the counter: "This is {B.first}. My {B.rel}."
Overheard: {A} to a passerby: "Have you met {B.first}? My {B.rel}."

sick: Comm, one side: {A}: "I'm fine now. Yes. Back at it."
parcel: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "Saw a drone at your door. Anything good?"
friends: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "Good seeing you the other day."
romance: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "So? How did it go?" {A} doesn't answer. Smiles.
Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "You look happy. Don't tell me, then."
work: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "Heard about work. You all right?"
Overheard: {B.desc}: "Rough week at work, I heard." {A} shrugs.
family: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "How's the family?" {A}: "Same as ever."
Comm, one side: {A}: "I know. I'll come by again soon."
home: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "All sorted at home?" {A}: "Getting there."
neighbors: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "Thanks again for the other day."
any: Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "Haven't seen you in a while. Busy?"
Overheard: {B.desc} to {A}: "Where have you been hiding?"

approach: {B.desc} up the block, headed this way.
Someone a few meters off, watching {A}.
comm: Comm buzzes twice. {A} checks it, puts it away.
{A} glances at the comm. Doesn't answer. Not yet.
drone: Drone traffic overhead. One drops lower.
A delivery drone holds above the block.
radio: Radio chatter on {A}'s shoulder. Not for this unit.
Radio: static, a unit number, static.
Radio: a call two districts over. {A} listens anyway.
resident: {B.desc} watching {A} from a few meters off.
generic: {A} stops at the curb. Waits a moment longer than the light.
{A} pauses. Turns a half step, then walks on.

heading: {A}, on foot, {S}.
On foot. {S}. Steady pace.
{A} heading {S}.
early: {A} out of {place} at {when}. Earlier than usual.
{when}. {A} leaves {place}. Ahead of the usual hour.
late: {A} out of {place} at {when}. Later than usual.
rain: Rain on the lens. {A} walking in it, no umbrella.
run: {A} running now. Rain coming down harder.
crowd: Crowded stretch. {n} people within a few meters of {A}.
{n} people close by. {A} moving through them.
empty: Nobody else on this stretch. {A} walking.
pass: {A} and {B} pass each other. Neither stops.
cop: Patrol officer a few meters off. {A} walks on.
Officer on the corner. {A} passes within a few meters.
neon: Neon on wet pavement. {A} crossing it.
Puddles take the signs. {A} walks through them.
sitting: {A} on a seat at {place}. Not moving on yet.

say: Overheard: "Music through the wall. Every night this week."
Overheard: "Someone keeps trying the door downstairs."
Overheard: "Same person at the corner three nights now. Just standing."
Overheard: "A drone left my parcel. Now it's gone."
Overheard: "Third delivery this month that never reached the door."
Overheard: "The stall next to mine is on my pitch again."
Overheard: "Someone took a crate off my stall. Right off the front."
Overheard: "I lost my comm. Somewhere between here and the station."
Overheard: "Dropped my keys. Have any been handed in?"
Overheard: "Which way to the metro? The lift's out."
Overheard: "I'm looking for the clinic. Is it near?"
Overheard: "You were here last week. With the mugging. Thank you."
Overheard: "Just wanted to say thanks. For the other night."

b2: {B.desc} talks fast. {A} listens, takes it down.
id: {A} logs the report. Name on the ID: {B.full}.
